data.name: Gudakesha
data.long_meaning: The name 'Gudakesha' is derived from Sanskrit words 'guda' meaning 'desire' and 'kesh' meaning 'hair or head'. This name signifies a person who has the strength and determination to subdue their desires and impulses. In Hindu mythology, the deity Lord Ganesha, who is also known as 'Gudakesha', is revered for his ability to control his senses and desires.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who overcomes inner desires for outer gains
